sample_unit: participants analyzed (322 genAI app, 209 digital workbook control)

links.outcome: Engagement and symptom change (GAD-7, PHQ-9) for genAI CBT app versus digital workbook, plus adverse events
links.effect: genAI raised engagement frequency 2.4x and duration 3.8x versus workbooks. Anxiety and depression outcomes were comparable, with no differences in adverse events. No overall symptom benefit.
links.quote: Over six weeks, the genAI solution (n = 322) increases engagement frequency (2.4×) and duration (3.8×) compared to digital workbooks (n = 209), with moderate to large effect sizes.

screen.reason: The study reports a randomized controlled trial testing a patient-facing genAI-enabled CBT app against digital workbooks to evaluate user engagement, clinical symptom reduction, and adverse events.
